description: This file defines the ComparisonOperator interface in Java, which serves as a marker interface for various comparison operator classes within the OpenMRS logic package. It includes static final instances of different comparison operators such as EQUALS, CONTAINS, GT, etc., which are likely instantiated from classes like Contains, Equals, GreaterThan, etc.

classes.name: ComparisonOperator
classes.description: A marker interface for comparison operators in the OpenMRS logic module, extended by specific comparison operator classes.
